Job Title: 2nd Shift Shredder Maintenance Technician

Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $17 to $19 per hour, Monday – Friday 3 pm to 11 pm or later.
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Position Summary
 
Under the direction of the Maintenance Person and upper-level maintenance personnel, the Maintenance Helper assists with repairs, setup, adjustments, welding, and lubrication activities in accordance with company policies and procedures.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Perform routine and basic maintenance tasks such as welding, changing filters, greasing and oiling shredders, balers, shears, conveyors, and similar equipment.
  • Set and adjust bearings, replace and adjust belts, drives, and idlers.
  • Assist upper-level maintenance personnel with moving and positioning parts, materials, and tools.
  • Disassemble and reassemble machines and equipment.
  • Operate company vehicle to pick up parts and materials locally.
  • Operate power lift equipment to move and position materials and supplies.
  • Perform torching activities as directed.
  • Notify supervisor of any problems or concerns related to equipment or tools.
  • Complete and maintain all required paperwork and documentation.
  • Follow and comply with all safety and work rules and regulations.
  • Maintain departmental housekeeping standards.
  • Plan work sequences to ensure effective completion of assignments.
  • Act as a technical resource to address and resolve inquiries and problems.
Qualifications
  • High school diploma required.
  • Up to six months of related experience preferred.
  • Ability to obtain lift equipment operator’s certificate.
  • Valid driver’s license may be required.
Skills and Abilities
  • Ability to read and comprehend basic instructions, blueprints, schematics, and symbols.
  • Ability to write standard correspondence and complete documentation.
  • Effective communication with other employees.
  • Apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed instructions.
  • Solve problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Perform basic math operations including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and compute rate, ratio, and percent.
 
Physical Demands
 
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and use hands to handle or feel. Occasional requirements include sitting, reaching, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and operating equipment with feet. Protective gear such as gloves, goggles, hard hat, safety glasses, and safety boots may be required in production areas. Must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

job.title: CNC Machine Operator
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a CNC Machine Operators (1st and 2nd Shift) to work at a company located in the Bloomingdale, IL area!

Job Title: CNC Machine Operators (1st and 2nd Shift)
 
Job Location: Bloomingdale, IL 60108
 
Pay and Hours for Job & Benefits:
Salary: $23.00-$28.00 per hour  
Shift/Hours:
1st shift:   6:00am-4:30pm
2nd Shift: 4:30pm-3:00am
 
Benefits: 
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • 401k Savings Plan
 
Job Description:               
Our growing manufacturing client in Bloomingdale, IL is looking to hire 1st and 2nd shift CNC Operators.     
 

Summary: 
The CNC Operator has critical areas of responsibility for setup and machining of parts on 3-axis and 5-axis grinding, milling, and EDM equipment to meet our increasing customer demand. A successful candidate will be a self-starter, committed to safety for self and the team, hungry to learn and make improvement, a high standard for quality and process compliance, and a team player.
 
Responsibilities:
• Sets up (or the ability to learn) and operates a 3-axis, Milling, EDM and/or 5-axis creep feed grinding machine to grind flat or contoured surfaces to customer specifications.
• Measures parts and reads measurement instruments using the following tools: Dial indicators, micrometers, calipers and plug gauges.
• Detailed quality assurance review of work on a continuous basis taking full ownership of the part operation assigned.
• Reviews operational processes and makes suggestions for process improvements in production, quality and company performance.
• Complete fixture tear-downs and machine set-ups as needed for a specified job.
• Identify the need for and complete grinding wheel changes when needed.
• Proactively complete daily asset care requirements and subsequently escalate as needed maintenance issues to the immediate supervisor and maintenance team using established maintenance ticket process.
• Must be able to run multiple machines, assuring cycle run times and quality, per business demands.
• Keep work area clean, organized and free from clutter. The machine must be wiped down each shift.
• Other duties as assigned.
 
Qualifications and Education:
 
• High school diploma or equivalent
• 1 year manufacturing experience in tight tolerance production.
• 5 axis and/or 3 axis and surface grinding experience required.
• Strong math skills demonstrated through assessment during hiring process.
• Must be able to measure parts within tight tolerances.
• Must be able to read indicators and use tools as detailed above.
• Ability to read, write, and speak English for customer, job and equipment specifications.
 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
• 3 years of experience EDM or wire/electrode EDM, preferred.
• 5S standards experience preferred.
• Prior experience working in aerospace manufacturing industry a plus.

Highly skilled operators may be considered for pay above the listed range based on experience and qualifications.

job.title: Tecnico de Limpieza - 2nd Shift
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Tecnico de Limpieza to work at a company located in the Elizabethtown, PA area!

Job Title: TÉCNICO DE LIMPIEZA
 
Job Location: Elizabethtown, PA
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $19.00 - $20.00
 
**¡ESTAMOS CONTRATANDO! – TÉCNICO DE LIMPIEZA**
 
Buscamos personal responsable y comprometido para trabajar como **Técnico de Limpieza en una planta de producción de alimentos.**
 
**PROPÓSITO DEL PUESTO**
 
El Técnico de Sanitizacion será responsable de la limpieza y sanitización de los equipos y áreas de producción, asegurando que se cumplan todos los procedimientos de seguridad alimentaria y calidad. La persona seleccionada deberá mantener las áreas de producción en condiciones sanitarias adecuadas y cumplir con las normas **GMP, HACCP, SSOP y SQF**.
 
**RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES**
 
• Realizar diariamente la limpieza y sanitización de las áreas de producción y equipos.
 
• Seguir correctamente todos los procedimientos **SSOP** relacionados con la limpieza y sanitización.
 
• Limpiar, desarmar, sanitizar y volver a ensamblar equipos de producción.
 
• Utilizar equipos de saneamiento como rociadores de presión, espumadores y otros equipos especializados.
 
• Participar en limpiezas profundas (**A-Cleans**), cambios de producto y limpieza al finalizar cada turno.
 
• Aplicar correctamente los procedimientos de limpieza y sanitización para prevenir contaminación cruzada y enfermedades transmitidas por alimentos.
 
• Manejar productos químicos de manera segura, incluyendo su preparación, dilución, almacenamiento y uso adecuado.
 
• Operar y mantener limpia la máquina para limpiar pisos.
 
• Retirar y desechar basura, operar la compactadora de cartón y desechar tarimas dañadas.
 
• Asistir con los procedimientos de **Clean Out of Place (COP)**.
 
• Completar correctamente los documentos y registros requeridos.
 
• Cumplir con las normas de seguridad, **GMP, HACCP y SQF** en todo momento.
 
• Mantener las condiciones sanitarias y contribuir a una sólida cultura de seguridad alimentaria.
 
• Mantener vigente la certificación y conocimientos necesarios para operar montacargas cuando sea requerido.
 
• Informar a FSQA o a la gerencia sobre cualquier condición que pueda afectar la seguridad de los alimentos, la calidad del producto o la seguridad del personal.
 
• Realizar otras tareas de saneamiento asignadas por el Técnico Líder de Saneamiento o el Gerente de FSQA.
 
**REQUISITOS**
 
• Experiencia previa en saneamiento, producción de alimentos o manufactura es preferida.
 
• Conocimiento de procedimientos de limpieza y sanitización.
 
• Capacidad para trabajar con productos químicos de manera segura.
 
• Conocimiento de normas GMP y HACCP es un plus.
 
• Capacidad para trabajar en un ambiente de producción de alimentos.
 
• Capacidad para seguir instrucciones y procedimientos establecidos.
 
• Disponibilidad para trabajar en equipo y cumplir con las normas de seguridad y calidad.
 
• Certificación de montacargas será considerada una ventaja.
 
**PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS**
 
Buscamos una persona responsable, puntual, trabajadora y comprometida con la seguridad alimentaria. Debe tener atención al detalle y estar dispuesta a mantener altos estándares de limpieza, calidad y seguridad.
 
**¡Si tienes experiencia en producción, saneamiento o manufactura de alimentos, queremos conocerte!**
 
Envía tu información para comenzar el proceso de contratación.

job.description:

Job Title: Director of Trade Compliance 
 
Job Location: Miami, FL 33172
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $140K per year 
 
Job Description: 
 
Director of Trade Compliance is responsible for leading and overseeing global trade compliance program, ensuring adherence to all applicable import and export regulations. This role partners closely with internal leadership, the Trade Compliance Manager (TCM), and third-party customs brokers to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant international trade operations.
 
The Director will drive strategic compliance initiatives, mitigate regulatory risks, optimize duty exposure, and ensure the organization operates in full compliance with U.S. and international trade laws, including EAR, OFAC, and BIS requirements.
 
Key accountabilities:
 
  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance company’s global trade compliance program.
  • Establish policies, procedures, and internal controls to ensure compliance with U.S., UK/EU, and international trade regulations.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on export controls, including EAR, OFAC sanctions, and BIS regulations.
  • Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on trade compliance risks, mitigation strategies, and business impacts.
  • Oversee classification management, including HS, HTS, Schedule B, and ECCN for all part numbers within the master database.
  • Ensure proper documentation, valuation, and country-of-origin determinations for all imports.
  • Provide clear instructions to freight forwarders and customs brokers to ensure smooth customs clearance.
  • Lead export compliance activities, including licensing determinations, screening, and documentation requirements.
  • Conduct end-use and end-user reviews to ensure compliance with export control regulations.
  • Assess transshipment and diversion risks and implement controls to mitigate exposure.
  • Lead internal audits, investigations, and compliance assessments.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory changes and ensure timely implementation across the organization.
  • Identify and implement strategies to minimize duty and tax exposure.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Operations to optimize unit pricing structures and duty savings opportunities.
  • Manage duty relief programs, including drawback and other applicable mechanisms.
  • Develop and deliver trade compliance training programs for relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Promote a culture of compliance and accountability across all business units.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of policies, procedures, and regulatory guidance.
  • Partner with the Trade Compliance Manager and manage relationships with third-party customs brokers and logistics providers.
  • Support high-volume inbound and outbound shipment activities with a focus on accuracy and timeliness.
  • Provide expert guidance in escalated or complex compliance matters, exercising sound, risk-based decision making.
Experience and qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent experience); advanced certifications in trade compliance are a plus
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in trade compliance, with progressive responsibility (10+ preferred for director level)
     Strong expertise in:
  • EAR (Export Administration Regulations)
  • OFAC sanctions compliance
  • BIS regulations and enforcement
  • End-use and end-user screening
  • Transshipment and diversion risk analysis
  • Extensive knowledge of:
  • ITAR and U.S. import/export regulations
  • UK/EU import requirements
  • Tariff classification, customs valuation, and country of origin rules
  • INCOTERMs and international logistics processes
  • Proven experience managing customs brokers and third-party logistics providers
  • Experience in the aviation industry strongly preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment
  • Proven experience with duty relief management, tariff classification, customs valuation and customs origins

job.title: Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance  to work at a company located in the Claremore, OK area!

Job Title: Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance 
 
Job Location: Claremore, Ok
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $25-$45 p/hr DOE 90 Day full benefits
 
Job Description:                                                           
 
Daily Duties & Responsibilities
  • Pre-Trip Inspections: Check truck fluids, tires, brakes, vacuum pumps, and secure all hoses and valves. 
  • Site Preparation: Locate underground tanks, dig to expose access lids using tools like a rock bar or soil probe, and manage physical labor on site. 
  • Waste Extraction: Hook up suction hoses, operate vacuum pump systems, and carefully monitor waste flow to prevent spills. 
  • Transportation & Disposal: Drive loaded tanker waste securely to an approved municipal or regional treatment facility. 
  • Customer Service: Answer client questions regarding the pumping process and note any structural damage or failing components inside the septic system. 

Equipment Maintenance Checklist
  • Daily Checks: Inspect suction hoses for cracks, soft spots, or loose clamps; test valves for smooth operation.
  • Weekly Tasks: Clear debris from tank baffles, clean sludge buildup, and inspect the primary shut-off float and manway gaskets.
  • Monthly & Routine Servicing: Check fluid levels, grease PTO shafts, inspect vacuum pump performance, and test vehicle battery terminals for corrosion.
 
Requirements
  • Reasonable Driving Background: CDL Preferred, not required. 
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to lift heavy items (frequently over 50 to 150 lbs) and work outdoors in varied weather conditions.
  • Safety & Compliance: Strict adherence to Department of Transportation (DOT) and environmental waste disposal guidelines.

job.title: Quality Assurance Supervisor
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Quality Assurance Supervisor  to work at a company located in the Opa Locka, FL area!

Job Title: Quality Assurance Supervisor  
 
Job Location: Opa Locka 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: M-F Direct Hire Health, Vision, Dental, 401k. $60-65,000/year
 
Job Description:          
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Supervisor to join our manufacturing team. This position will lead the Quality Assurance team, maintain and improve quality systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and support continuous improvement initiatives throughout the organization.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience with cGMP, FDA regulations, ISO 9001, CAPA, root cause analysis, audits, validation, calibration, and quality systems, along with previous leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Ensure adherence to the company Quality System and applicable regulatory requirements. 
  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA). 
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS). 
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing 5S, Kaizen, Lean, and Six Sigma methodologies. 
  • Develop and conduct quality awareness and compliance training. 
  • Support Engineering and Operations with the transfer of products and processes into Production. 
  • Provide leadership and support to Quality Inspectors and ensure compliance with QMS requirements. 
  • Conduct and support internal and external audits and ensure findings are properly addressed. 
  • Investigate product failures and customer complaints and implement corrective actions. 
  • Develop, maintain, and revise quality manuals, procedures, SOPs, and other controlled documentation. 
  • Oversee receiving and outgoing quality activities. 
  • Improve receiving inspection processes and procedures. 
  • Investigate supplier quality failures and implement corrective actions. 
  • Monitor and evaluate supplier quality performance. 
  • Develop and maintain quality reports, metrics, and documentation. 
  • Establish and maintain appropriate measurement methods and equipment. 
  • Analyze quality data and utilize problem-solving techniques to improve manufacturing processes. 
  • Train Quality and Production personnel on quality procedures and requirements. 
  • Work cross-functionally with Production, Engineering, Purchasing, suppliers, and customers to resolve quality issues. 
  • Support and implement Lean and Six Sigma continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Ensure compliance with applicable ISO 9001, OSHA, FDA, and GMP requirements. 
  • Maintain and oversee the calibration program. 
  • Develop and execute validation protocols and the Validation Master Plan. 
  • Provide leadership, coaching, training, and development to Quality personnel. 

Qualifications
  • Previous Quality Assurance/Quality Control experience within a manufacturing environment. 
  • Previous experience leading or supervising Quality personnel. 
  • Strong knowledge of FDA regulations, cGMP, ISO 9001, QMS, CAPA, root cause analysis, audits, validation, and calibration. 
  • Experience with Lean/Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies preferred. 
  • Strong documentation, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills. 

Salary: $60,000–$65,000 annually.

job.title: Senior HR Business Partner
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Bilingual Senior Human Resources Business Partner to work at a manufacturing company located in the Bloomingdale, IL area!

Job Title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner (Bilingual)
 
Job Location: Bloomingdale, IL 60108
 
Salary: $100,000-$115,000 base plus bonus 
 
 
Job Description    
                                 
 
Position Summary:

The Senior Human Resources Business Partner (Sr. HRBP) serves as a strategic and hands-on partner to leadership, driving both day-to-day HR operations and long-term organizational effectiveness. This role is critical in supporting the company’s planned growth and scaling initiatives, with a focus on building strong talent pipelines, enhancing organizational culture, and implementing scalable HR processes across multiple locations.
Primarily supporting manufacturing operations in Bloomingdale and Glendale Heights, IL (additional manufacturing sites in NM and NC as support is required), this role requires a balance of strategic insight and tactical execution across all facets of Human Resources. The Sr. HRBP will influence leaders at all levels, lead change initiatives, and ensure HR practices align with business objectives to enable the organization to scale effectively.
The ideal candidate is a proactive, results-driven HR professional with experience in manufacturing environments, known for strong communication, sound judgment, and the ability to drive measurable improvements in culture, engagement, and performance.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
Strategic Business Partnership
  • Partner with leadership to align HR strategies with business objectives, supporting organizational growth and scalability. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, and talent development. 
  • Drive change management initiatives to support business transformation and continuous improvement. 
Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning
  • Lead full-cycle recruitment strategies for hourly and salaried roles, ensuring alignment with growth goals. 
  • Partner with hiring managers to forecast workforce needs and build proactive talent pipelines. 
  • Enhance employer branding and recruitment processes to attract high-quality talent in a competitive manufacturing market. 
Employee Relations & Culture
  • Lead and manage complex employee relations issues, including investigations, corrective actions, and conflict resolution. 
  • Champion a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture across all locations. 
  • Identify trends and implement initiatives to improve engagement, retention, and employee experience. 
Performance Management & Talent Development
  • Provide coaching and guidance to leaders on performance management, employee development, and succession planning. 
  • Facilitate performance and compensation review processes, ensuring consistency and fairness. 
  • Support leadership capability development through training and coaching. 
HR Operations & Compliance
  • Oversee core HR processes including onboarding, offboarding, benefits administration, leaves of absence (FMLA, STD, workers’ compensation), and HRIS data integrity. 
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local employment laws across multiple locations. 
  • Maintain and improve HR policies, procedures, and employee handbook. 
Process Improvement & HR Infrastructure
  • Evaluate and enhance HR processes to support scalability and operational efficiency. 
  • Leverage HRIS and data analytics to drive insights, reporting, and decision-making. 
  • Lead or support HR-related projects, including system implementations and process standardization. 
Employee Engagement & Communication
  • Develop and execute engagement initiatives, including wellness and recognition programs. 
  • Deliver clear, consistent, and effective communication across all levels of the organization. 
  • Serve as a visible and accessible HR presence on the plant floor and within the office environment. 
Leadership & Team Support
  • May directly manage or mentor HR team members, including recruiting support. 
  • Serve as a backup to the Human Resources Director as needed. 
 
 
Qualifications & Education:
 
 
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) is required. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or related field required 
  • 8+ years of progressive HR experience, preferably within a manufacturing environment 
  • Master's degree or HR-related certification (SHRM-CP/SPHR) preferred
  • Demonstrated success in: 
    • Driving organizational change and growth initiatives 
    • Improving employee engagement and culture 
    • Building and optimizing HR processes 
    • Influencing and coaching leaders 
  • Strong employee relations experience, including handling complex situations independently 
  • Experience supporting multi-site operations; multi-state experience preferred 
 
Technical & Professional Skills
 
  • Experience with HRIS systems (Paycom or similar required) 
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills (advanced Excel proficiency preferred) 
  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal 
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • High level of discretion and confidentiality 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment 
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision and highly collaborative
 

 
Benefits: 
 
Employee benefits include:
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • 401k Savings Plan

Job Description:                                                          
Septic installer and maintenance technician will install, repair, and service onsite wastewater treatment systems for residential and commercial properties.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Installation: Excavate sites, set septic tanks, lay distribution pipes, and construct drain fields according to local building codes and permits. 
  • Maintenance & Pumping: Locate system components, uncover access lids, and operate pump trucks to remove accumulated sludge and waste. 
  • Inspection & Diagnostics: Assess structural integrity, check liquid levels and baffles, inspect pumps and filters, and troubleshoot system failures.
  • Repairs: Replace damaged pipes, broken baffles, failing pumps, or worn-out risers and valves. 
  • Site Work: Operate heavy machinery like mini-excavators, skid steers, and trenchers, followed by proper backfilling and site grading.
 
Qualifications & Requirements
 
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to lift heavy objects (often 50 to 150 lbs) and perform strenuous outdoor labor in all weather conditions.
  • Equipment Skills: Experience operating excavation machinery and specialized plumbing or pumping tools.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of local environmental and health regulations regarding wastewater disposal
  • 90 days will move to permanent employee, and become eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401k program.

job.title: Maintenance Storeroom Clerk
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Store Clerk to work at a company located in the Downingtown, PA  area!

Job Title: Maintenance Storeroom Clerk – Temp- On-Site
 
Job Location: Downingtown, PA
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $25.00 AN HOUR
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
MAINTENANCE STOREROOM CLERK
M-F 7:00am - 3:30pm PLUS OT  on occasion- ON SITE
The Storeroom Clerk creates and maintains purchase orders to support plant maintenance activities, monitors and adjusts storeroom inventory levels, and maintains records for items sent out for repair. This position is responsible for maintaining the organization, cleanliness, and overall appearance of storeroom areas. The Storeroom Clerk also responds to requests from maintenance and production personnel by providing timely access to the parts, supplies, and materials needed to support plant equipment and operations.
QUILIFICATIONS /EXPERIENCE
•           Minimum education required: High School Diploma or equivalent
•           Education desired: Associate Degree
•           Relevant experience: Two or more years of related experience
•           Competency in SAP, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
•           Prior SAP experience
•           Knowledge of inventory management practices and inventory control systems
•           Ability to accurately receive, issue, count, and track parts and materials
•           Strong organizational and recordkeeping skills
•           Strong communication and customer service skills
•           Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
•           Ability to work independently while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
RESPONSIBILITIES
•           Manage storeroom inventory, including reviewing slow-moving and obsolete parts.
•           Coordinate and maintain records associated with the repair and return program.
•           Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve inventory effectiveness.
•           Maintain storeroom stock levels to support maintenance and production needs.
•           Ensure receipts, inventory transactions, and system records are current and accurate.
•           Maintain inventory control systems and support inventory improvement initiatives.
•           Provide timely and professional service to maintenance and production personnel.
•           Notify the Maintenance Manager when established charge-out or return procedures are not followed.
•           Support storeroom KPI tracking and reporting.
•           Maintain a clean, safe, and organized storeroom.
Job Complexity
•           Receive maintenance, repair, and operating supplies, commonly referred to as MRO items, using material management systems, including SAP and Excel-generated reports.
•           Receive materials accurately and match incoming items to the appropriate purchase orders or records.
•           Perform accurate cycle counts, post adjustments in a timely manner, and maintain accurate inventory records and valid information in SAP.
•           Maintain the integrity of material master and part information in SAP.
•           Issue maintenance items against SAP work orders.
•           Initiate the purchase order process for emergency MRO items when required.
•           Enter stock disbursements in SAP.
•           Coordinate the dispatch of items being sent out for repair or return.
•           Develop and maintain Bills of Materials, or BOMs, for equipment in SAP.
•           Ensure proper shipping procedures are followed when items are removed from the building.
•           Complete necessary follow-up for outstanding, open, and backordered purchase order items.
•           Identify maintenance items as stock or non-stock to support proper replenishment and reordering.
•           Restock bins following the receipt of parts and supplies.
•           Retrieve and process goods issue tickets from satellite storerooms.
•           Obtain Return Material Authorization, or RMA, numbers from suppliers as needed.
•           Communicate with suppliers as required.
•           Maintain plant-specific standard operating procedures and support company strategies for MRO management.
•           Assist with KPI tracking and reporting.
•           Operate a lift truck and walk-behind hand truck.
•           Perform housekeeping duties to maintain clean, safe, and organized storeroom areas.
•           Comply with all Company policies, procedures, safety requirements, and Good Manufacturing Practices.
•           Perform other duties as assigned by the Maintenance Manager.
Working Conditions
•           Must be capable of lifting up to 50 pounds.
•           Must be able to operate a lift truck and walk-behind hand truck, as required.
•           Must be able to work in a manufacturing and storeroom environment.
•           Must comply with plant safety requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices, and required personal protective equipment standards.

Job Description:
The Senior Accountant will play a key role in the month-end close process, financial reporting, account reconciliations, and process improvements. This role requires a deep understanding of U.S. GAAP, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hands-on NetSuite ERP experience, including GL, Fixed Assets, AP/AR, and reporting functions, is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, internal controls, and accounting operations in a growth-oriented company.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, V-lookup, etc.).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

job.title: Mechanical & Controls Estimator
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a  Mechanical & Controls Estimator to work at a company located in the Fort Lauderdale, FL area!

Job Title: Mechanical & Controls Estimator   
 
Job Location: Fort Lauderdale 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $90,000 – $105,000 direct hire health, vision, dental, 401k
 
Job Description:          
The Mechanical / BMS Controls Estimator is responsible for reviewing project plans, specifications, and drawings to develop accurate and comprehensive estimates for mechanical systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), and HVAC controls.
This position requires a strong understanding of mechanical and controls systems, estimating principles, project costing, and the integration of building automation systems with HVAC and other building equipment. The Estimator will work closely with Project Management, Engineering, Operations, Sales, subcontractors, and vendors throughout the bidding and project turnover process. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Evaluate bid specifications and drawings for mechanical and BMS control systems, including chilled water, condenser water, glycol, refrigeration, and other mechanical systems. 
  • Review electrical systems as they relate to controls scope and system integration. 
  • Develop RFIs, clarifications, and scope reviews to ensure a complete understanding of project requirements. 
  • Perform accurate takeoffs and develop detailed cost estimates for controls, mechanical systems, and associated components. 
  • Analyze project requirements and identify potential technical challenges, labor constraints, integration issues, and other factors that could impact project budgets or execution. 
  • Understand low-voltage BMS controls, control system topology, networking requirements, and interfaces between controls, mechanical equipment, and building systems. 
  • Evaluate the integration of building automation systems with HVAC equipment, lighting controls, generators, and other building systems. 
  • Determine controls and mechanical scope requirements and identify integrated versus non-integrated equipment. 
  • Perform comprehensive bid-day analysis and scope reviews. 
  • Review bid requirements and identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and items requiring clarification. 
  • Prepare subcontractor bid packages and ensure appropriate vendor and subcontractor participation. 
  • Develop and maintain relationships with subcontractors and vendors while soliciting and evaluating quotations. 
  • Communicate project schedules, bid requirements, and addenda to vendors and subcontractors. 
  • Create and maintain bid lists to ensure appropriate coverage for each project. 
  • Enter and maintain project and estimating information within estimating software and internal systems. 
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Engineers, Operations, and Sales to ensure estimates and scope assumptions align with operational capabilities. 
  • Ensure bid documents, vendor quotations, subcontractor information, scope assumptions, and project details are accurately transferred to the Project Management team. 
  • Review drawings and project costs with Project Management and identify potential risks or areas of concern. 
  • Conduct site visits as needed to support retrofit opportunities and estimate development. 
  • Maintain effective communication with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal departments. 
  • Submit bids, budgets, and estimating deliverables within established deadlines. 

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field preferred. 
  • 3–5 years of experience within construction, project environments, estimating, or related business operations. 
  • Experience with or willingness to learn Mechanical Systems, BMS, BAS, HVAC controls, and related technologies. 
  • Understanding of low-voltage control systems, controls integration, and mechanical equipment applications. 
  • Understanding of chilled water, condenser water, and refrigeration systems. 
  • Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, addenda, drawings, and RFIs. 
  • Understanding of estimating principles, margins, and project costing. 
  • Experience using estimating software. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Project. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities. 
  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills. 
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to learning and professional development. 
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus. 

Benefits
Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package are offered.

job.title: Local CDL Driver
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a CDL Driver  to work at a company located in the Rogers, AR area!

Job Title: CDL Driver

 

Job Location: Rogers 

 

Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: Up to $26/hr, Mon-Fri 6:30AM-4PM 

 

Position Summary: CDL Driver that is dependable, safety conscious. The driver will be responsible for safely operating company commercial motor vehicles, including standard manual transmission trucks—to transport scrap materials, roll-off containers, or structural steel products between our facility, local suppliers, and customer locations  

 

Key Responsibilities:  

Transport Operations: Safely drive and operate commercial trucks (such as roll-offs, flatbeds, or tractor-trailers), utilizing manual transmissions to navigate various road and yard conditions. 

 

Route Management: Navigate local and regional routes efficiently while strictly adhering to all Department of Transportation (DOT) rules, local traffic laws, and company safety guidelines. 

 

Loading & Unloading: Assist with or manage the secure loading, tarping, and unloading of materials, ensuring proper weight distribution and securement using chains, binders, or straps. 

 

Container Service: Drop off, pick up, and position roll-off or storage containers at commercial and industrial customer sites as requested. 

 

Vehicle Inspections: Conduct thorough pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the vehicle and equipment, documenting any mechanical issues or maintenance needs immediately. 

 

Yard Support: Assist with general scrap yard operations, material sorting, or equipment loading when not driving. 

Position Requirements:  

License: Valid Commercial Driver’s License (Class A or Class B CDL depending on assigned fleet equipment) without an airbrake restriction. 

 

Manual Transmission Proficiency: Required. Must have proven, hands-on experience and proficiency in operating heavy-duty commercial vehicles with manual transmissions (e.g., 8-speed, 9-speed, 10-speed, or similar shift patterns) without relying on automatic-only restrictions. 

 

Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of verifiable commercial driving experience; prior experience in the recycling, construction, or heavy-haul industry is strongly preferred. 

 

Certifications: Must maintain a valid DOT medical card and pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check. 

 

Physical Demands: Ability to sit for long periods, operate a clutch and manual shifter repeatedly, walk on uneven scrap-yard surfaces, climb ladders/stairs on trucks and trailers, and regularly lift up to 50 lbs.

Job Description: 
Warehouse Worker 
Location: Medina, OH
Pay Rate: $16.00 per hour
Shift: Multiple shifts available (see below)

Job Overview
We are seeking dependable Warehouse Associates to support daily distribution center operations. This role involves operating material handling equipment (MHE), using RF scanners, and performing a variety of warehouse functions including stocking, receiving, replenishment, and order selection.

Responsibilities
Stocking
  • Shift: 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM
  • Operate order pickers and reach trucks
  • Hand stack or place full pallets of product into designated locations
  • Use RF scanners to accurately track inventory movements
Replenishment

  • Ability to perform physical tasks including lifting, stacking, and standing for extended periods
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Dependable attendance and work ethic
Work Environment
  • Fast-paced warehouse/distribution center setting
  • Team-based operation with safety and accuracy as top priorities
  • Temperature-controlled and non-temperature-controlled areas depending on department

job.title: Maintenance Technician - New Haven, CT
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Bilingual Maintenance Technician to work at a company located in the New Haven, CT area!

Job Title:  Bilingual Maintenance Technician
 
Job Location: New Haven, CT
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits We are hiring an experienced Bilingual Maintenance Technician for a food manufacturing facility in New Haven, CT. This is a full-time, hands-on maintenance position responsible for keeping production equipment operating safely and efficiently while minimizing downtime.
What You'll Do
  • Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain industrial production and packaging equipment.
  • Perform mechanical repairs on conveyors, motors, gearboxes, pumps, bearings, and related equipment.
  • Respond to equipment breakdowns and make timely repairs to minimize production downtime.
  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance and document completed work in a CMMS system.
  • Inspect equipment for wear, leaks, unusual noise, and other potential problems.
  • Troubleshoot pneumatic and hydraulic systems and mechanical power transmission equipment.
  • Support facility systems including piping, HVAC components, lighting, and compressed air.
  • Assist with refrigeration, boiler, and water systems as qualified.
  • Perform basic electrical troubleshooting, including sensors, electrical schematics, and use of a multimeter.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis and recommend improvements to prevent recurring equipment failures.
  • Follow OSHA, SQF, food safety, and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) requirements.
  • Work closely with production personnel to troubleshoot equipment and improve reliability.
Requirements
  • 3–5 years of industrial maintenance or industrial mechanic experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Strong mechanical troubleshooting and repair skills.
  • Experience with conveyors, motors, bearings, pumps, pneumatics, hydraulics, and mechanical power transmission.
  • Ability to read blueprints, mechanical drawings, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficiency with hand tools, power tools, and precision measuring equipment.
  • Working knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work safely under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Basic electrical skills, including reading schematics, replacing sensors, and using a multimeter.
  • Food manufacturing experience is strongly preferred but not required.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience in an SQF- or USDA-regulated food manufacturing facility.
  • Welding and fabrication experience, including MIG/TIG, cutting, and grinding.
  • Trade school, technical certification, apprenticeship, or other formal industrial maintenance training.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to stand, walk, climb, kneel, bend, and work on your feet for extended periods.
  • Routinely lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs; occasionally up to 75 lbs.
  • Comfortable working around moving machinery, vibration, wet conditions, cleaning chemicals, and food-processing equipment.
  • Ability to work in varying temperatures, including cold rooms and warm processing areas.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, including steel-toe shoes, hearing protection, and eye protection.

What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is a dependable, hands-on maintenance professional who can diagnose problems quickly, make quality repairs, and take a proactive approach to preventing equipment failures. Food manufacturing experience is a plus, but strong industrial maintenance experience is the priority.
Pay: $28.50–$29.50/hour
Monday–Friday | 3:00 PM–11:30 PM
Full-Time | New Haven, CT
English/Spanish Bilingual Required

job.title: Accounting Clerk
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Accounting Clerk  to work at a company located in the Gravette, AR area!

Job Title: Accounting Clerk 

 

Job Location: Gravette 

 

Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: Up to $18/hr, Mon-Fri 8AM-5PM 

 

Position Summary: 

The Accounting Clerk is responsible for providing comprehensive accounting support by computing, classifying, and recording numerical data to maintain accurate financial records. This position manages the full cycle of accounts payable and accounts receivable, ensuring files are complete, payments are processed timely, and customer/vendor accounts remain in good standing. The Accounting Clerk provides high-level support to accounting supervisors, managers, and other department staff to ensure the integrity of the company’s financial operations. 

 

Key Responsibilities:  

Perform accounting and clerical functions to support supervisors; research, track, and resolve  complex accounting problems and discrepancies.  

Code and input data (invoices, checks, account statements, reports) into financial processing  systems according to company procedures; work in QuickBooks to support the company.  

Review A/P for accuracy and ensure proper approvals are in place; process credit cards  payable and accounts payable to ensure payments are current; audit bills against purchase orders.  

Generate and distribute customer invoices, credit memos, internal sales orders, and account  statements; add, receive, and post customer payments and credits to specific accounts.  

Manage the collections process for past-due accounts, conferring with customers to resolve  payment delays; audit invoices against purchase orders and research discrepancies.  

Prepare checks, account statements, and reports; assist with project and job cost reporting;  reconcile report discrepancies and assist with expense report tracking.  

Compile and sort documents (bills, checks, purchase orders) substantiating business  transactions; maintain digital and physical records by scanning and filing.  

Assist employees, vendors, clients, or customers by answering questions related to accounts,  procedures, and services.  

Assist with licensing compliance and other regulatory documentation.  

Assist with special projects and perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Job Title:  Microbiologist – Raw Materials 
 
Job Location: Miramar, FL 33025

Job Description:
Position Summary
Seeking a Microbiologist to support Quality Control and laboratory operations within a cGMP nutraceutical manufacturing environment. This position is responsible for microbiological testing of raw materials, finished products, water systems, environmental samples, and manufacturing areas to ensure compliance with established quality and regulatory standards.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform microbiological testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished nutraceutical products.
  • Conduct environmental monitoring of manufacturing and laboratory areas.

  • Assist Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
  • Follow all company SOPs, cGMP requirements, safety procedures, and laboratory practices.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Microbiology, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline preferred.
  • Previous microbiology laboratory experience in a nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, food, cosmetic, or regulated manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Knowledge of cGMP, GLP, SOPs, and microbiological laboratory practices.
  • Experience with environmental monitoring and microbial testing strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with USP microbiological testing methods is a plus.
  • Strong documentation, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to investigate laboratory deviations and microbiological results.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a Quality Control laboratory team.
Preferred Experience
  • Nutraceutical or dietary supplement manufacturing

  • Water-system testing

job.title: Avionics Repair Technician II
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Avionics Repair Technician to work at a company located in the Miami, FL area!

Job Title: Avionics Repair Technician
Job Location: Miami
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:
Salary $28/hr to $30/HR

Job Description:
The Repair Technician II is responsible for inspecting, troubleshooting, repairing and testing communication, navigation and flight control (ATC, ADF, TCAS, Audio) panels.
 
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  1. Performs repairs by conducting various functional tests on single, dual and multiple head control panels (TCAS, ACP, mechanical units) to diagnose and troubleshoot component boards to the component level.
  2. Uses standard test equipment such as power supplies, multimeters which measure voltage/current/resistance, function generators, and oscilliscopes.
  3. Adjusts and replaces defective or improperly functioning circuitry and electronic components (thru hole or surface mount) using hand tools such as pliers, screwdrivers, soldering irons and vacuum desoldering guns.
  4. Consults technical manuals, test procedures, schematics and wiring diagrams to solve component and circuit problems.
  5. Provides written repair estimates to customers as necessary based on complexity of repair work.
  6. Enters description of work completed on work orders and properly documents removal and installation of parts in accordance with FAA traceability standards.
  7. Tracks and closes work orders using in-house IFS ERP system.
 
JOB SKILLS REQUIRED:
  1. Strong electronic theory and troubleshooting skills (component level)
  2. Ability to read and interpret drawing, schematics, and technical manuals.
  3. Knowledge of various test equipment to include multimeters, oscilloscopes, and other special avionic test equipment to support environmental testing.
  4. Good organizational skills and the ability to support several projects and engineers while balancing priorities and schedules as necessary.
  5. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate well with employees at all levels.
 
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:
  1. A.S. degree in electronics or equivalent military/technical trade experience.
  2. 5+ years of electronics experience (avionics preferred)
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
  1. Light Work- This role may require exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently to lift carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Most essential functions are performed while sitting but walking and standing is occasionally required.
  2. Manual dexterity is required in the assembly or fabrication of parts which may result in the repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, and fingers.

Job Title: Maintenance Technician

Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $25.00 p/hr
 
Job Description:
 
Maintenance Technician (Mechanical/Electrical)
Department: Maintenance
Reports To: Maintenance Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt (Hourly)
Job Type: Full-Time, Regular
Position Summary
The Maintenance Technician is responsible for the safe, efficient, and effective maintenance, repair, and continuous improvement of company machinery, equipment, and facilities. This role supports production by ensuring equipment reliability and compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
Essential Functions
The following duties are considered essential functions of this position:
  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance on mechanical, electrical, and electronic equipment
  • Diagnose and repair equipment failures, including electrical and electronic systems at the component level
  • Maintain compliance with BRC standards and the Product Safety and Quality Management System (PSQMS)
  • Adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and report any food safety or quality concerns
  • Participate in required safety activities including lockout/tagout procedures, equipment labeling, inspections, and emergency response protocols
  • Build or modify equipment, fixtures, and electrical systems as directed
  • Maintain maintenance records and documentation in accordance with company and regulatory requirements
  • Understand and comply with procedures governing temporary repairs and maintenance clearance
  • Support continuous improvement and reliability initiatives
  • Perform related duties as assigned to support operations and quality systems
Qualifications
Required:
  • Technical training and/or demonstrated experience in one or more of the following: electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, welding, or carpentry
Preferred:
  • Associate degree in electrical, electronics, or a related technical field
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair industrial equipment
  • Basic understanding of electrical schematics and mechanical systems
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and safe work practices
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
Work Environment and Physical Requirements
The work environment and physical demands described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Work performed in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, moving machinery, and varying temperatures
  • Required to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Ability to access all areas of the facility, including elevated platforms, confined spaces, and exterior areas, as required to perform job duties
  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, and reaching
  • Ability to climb ladders and work at heights
  • Ability to lift and move materials up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation
Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.
Additional Responsibilities and Conditions
  • Access to various areas of the facility as necessary to perform maintenance functions
  • May occasionally interact with vendors, contractors, or internal stakeholders
  • Required to complete company-provided training, including hazardous materials handling
Equipment Used
  • Forklifts and powered industrial vehicles
  • Hand and power tools
  • Electrical and electronic testing equipment
  • Welding equipment
  • Personal protective equipment (PPE)

The Quality Control Inspector- Ensures aviation articles meet manufacturer and operator specifications, including Dimensions, condition, operational limits, and compliance with the company’s Quality Management System.  Essential Job Functions:

Job Description:          
Position Requirements & Responsibilities
Employees will operate injection molding presses and/or perform hand assembly operations, including loading parts, running production cycles, inspecting and packaging finished products, and preparing products for shipment. All employees are expected to follow work instructions, quality standards, safety procedures, and customer requirements while meeting established productivity targets.
Physical & Environmental Requirements
  • This is a standing position. Employees must remain on their feet throughout the shift except during scheduled breaks (two paid breaks and one 15-minute unpaid lunch). Seating is not available at the press.

  • Must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Good vision is required, including close vision, distance vision, color recognition, and depth perception.
  • Work is performed in a manufacturing environment around moving machinery, with moderate noise levels and occasional exposure to heat, fumes, and airborne particles.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Operate injection molding presses and perform assembly tasks in accordance with established work instructions.
  • Review and follow all production, inspection, quality, and packaging requirements before starting work.
  • Monitor product quality and perform required inspections.
  • Accurately record production data, including quantities produced, scrap, labels, and other required documentation.
  • Package and label products according to specifications.
  • Report equipment malfunctions, production concerns, safety hazards, and quality issues promptly to the Supervisor or Plant Manager.
  • Maintain required production rates and productivity standards.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, quality personnel, and coworkers.

Qualifications & Skills
  • Previous injection molding experience is preferred but not required; successful completion of company training is required.

Job Description:                                                                               
JobSquad is seeking reliable and detail-oriented Molding Operators to join our client in Battle Creek, MI that is a leading manufacturer of advanced fiber-based products designed to solve noise, vibration, and thermal challenges in the automotive and industrial sectors. This position supports molding, oven, and trimming operations in a fast-paced production environment. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, dependable, and committed to producing high-quality products while meeting production goals.
 
• Previous manufacturing or production experience preferred
• Experience working in a fast-paced production environment preferred
• Strong hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity
• High attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to read and follow written instructions, SOPs, and work instruction
• Basic computer skills for data entry and production tracking
• Reliable attendance and punctuality
• Strong communication and teamwork skills
• Ability to work overtime as needed
• Must be able to pass a drug screen and background check
 
 
Physical Requirements
• Ability to regularly lift 50 pounds
• Ability to stand and walk for 8–10-hour shifts
• Frequent bending, twisting, stooping, reaching, and repetitive movements
• Ability to work near industrial ovens and manufacturing equipment
• Ability to work in a non-climate-controlled environment with varying temperatures
• Comfortable working in a loud, fast-paced manufacturing environment
• Ability to wear required PPE, including safety glasses, gloves, sleeves, and other protective equipment
 
Responsibilities of position
  1. Monitor oven cycles to ensure proper temperature, timing, and product quality
  2. prepare materials for production by staging fiber blankets and loading them into industrial ovens according to specifications
  3. Transfer heated materials into molds and operate molding equipment to form parts
  4. Operate waterjet and/or trim press equipment to remove excess material and finish parts
  5. Perform in-process and final quality inspections to identify defects or inconsistencies
  6. Label, package, and document finished products according to company standards
  7. Track production, material usage, and scrap in the Plex system
  8. Report on equipment issues, quality concerns, and safety hazards to leadership
  9. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area following 5S standards
  10. Work independently and collaboratively to meet production goals
  11. Follow all company policies, procedures, and safety guidelines
  12. Support continuous improvement initiatives and perform other duties as assigned

job.title: 2026 Road Construction Flagger
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Road Construction Flagger  to work at a company located in the Grand Rapids, MI area!

Job Title: 
Road Construction Flagger 
 
Job Location: 
Statewide Hiring Locations: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Jackson, Mount Pleasant
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:
Hourly rate is based on the one-way distance from your home office to the assigned job site, calculated using the shortest available route in Google Maps.
  • 0–49 miles: $20.00/hour
  • 50–79 miles: $21.00/hour
  • 80–99 miles: $22.00/hour
  • 100+ miles: $27.00/hour 
 
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
What the Job Looks Like
  • Schedules are shared daily through our dispatch app (Assignar), by 7:00 PM each night.
  • Shifts typically range from 4 to 14 hours, depending on weather and project needs. (Not including travel time)
  • Work sites change daily. Statewide travel is required.
  • Overtime opportunities are available.
  • Because of the nature of roadwork, scheduled breaks aren’t always guaranteed—but we do our best to make sure you get rest when site conditions allow.
 
 
What You’ll Need
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Reliable personal vehicle (must remain on-site during your shift)
  • Proof of auto insurance (in your name/listed as an insured driver)
  • Availability for full days (sunrise to sunset), including weekends.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • No OWI/DUI within the past 5 years
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.
  • Willingness to travel up to 100+ miles one way.
 
No experience? No problem. We provide training and safety equipment.
 
As a flagger, you’re an important part of keeping both workers and drivers safe. Your responsibilities include:
  • Controlling traffic through construction zones
  • Guiding drivers safely around work areas
  • Using signs, paddles, radios, and hand signals
  • Communicating with your team to keep traffic flowing smoothly.
 
PPE Provided by JobSquad:
  • Safety vest (MDOT Class 3)
  • Safety glasses (clear & tinted)
  • Hard hat
  • Sign & Poles
  • Headlamp
  • 2-way radio (you provide batteries)
  • Poncho
 
You’ll need to bring:
  • T-shirt or long-sleeved shirt (no tank tops)
  • Steel-toed leather boots (ankle coverage required)
  • Durable jeans or work pants (no shorts or sweatpants)
 
We’ve got you covered with a full range of benefits, including:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability coverage
Plus, we offer a $100 referral bonus for every friend you bring on board—no limit.
 
Text “FLAG” to 269-279-7222 to apply!

job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Road Construction Flagger  to work at a company located in the Jackson, MI area!

Job Title: 
Road Construction Flagger 
 
Job Location: 
Statewide Hiring Locations: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Jackson, Mount Pleasant
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:
Hourly rate is based on the one-way distance from your home office to the assigned job site, calculated using the shortest available route in Google Maps.
  • 0–49 miles: $20.00/hour
  • 50–79 miles: $21.00/hour
  • 80–99 miles: $22.00/hour
  • 100+ miles: $27.00/hour 
 
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
What the Job Looks Like
  • Schedules are shared daily through our dispatch app (Assignar), by 7:00 PM each night.
  • Shifts typically range from 4 to 14 hours, depending on weather and project needs. (Not including travel time)
  • Work sites change daily. Statewide travel is required.
  • Overtime opportunities are available.
  • Because of the nature of roadwork, scheduled breaks aren’t always guaranteed—but we do our best to make sure you get rest when site conditions allow.
 
 
What You’ll Need
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Reliable personal vehicle (must remain on-site during your shift)
  • Proof of auto insurance (in your name/listed as an insured driver)
  • Availability for full days (sunrise to sunset), including weekends.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • No OWI/DUI within the past 5 years
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.
  • Willingness to travel up to 100+ miles one way.
 
No experience? No problem. We provide training and safety equipment.
 
As a flagger, you’re an important part of keeping both workers and drivers safe. Your responsibilities include:
  • Controlling traffic through construction zones
  • Guiding drivers safely around work areas
  • Using signs, paddles, radios, and hand signals
  • Communicating with your team to keep traffic flowing smoothly.
 
PPE Provided by JobSquad:
  • Safety vest (MDOT Class 3)
  • Safety glasses (clear & tinted)
  • Hard hat
  • Sign & Poles
  • Headlamp
  • 2-way radio (you provide batteries)
  • Poncho
 
You’ll need to bring:
  • T-shirt or long-sleeved shirt (no tank tops)
  • Steel-toed leather boots (ankle coverage required)
  • Durable jeans or work pants (no shorts or sweatpants)
 
We’ve got you covered with a full range of benefits, including:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability coverage
Plus, we offer a $100 referral bonus for every friend you bring on board—no limit.
 
Text “FLAG” to 269-279-7222 to apply!
 

The JobSquad Solutions Team is made up of experts around the country. Serving our local workforce communities is our passion. 
#ADV123456

job.title: CNC / Lathe Machinist
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a CNC / Lathe Machinist to work at a company located in the Paw Paw, MI area!

Job Title: CNC / Lathe Machinist
 
Job Location: Paw Paw, MI 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: 7AM-3PM $18-$25/hour (Could vary)
 
 
Job Description:
 
Die Cast Press is growing and seeking a responsible, innovative CNC/Lathe Machinist with strong machining knowledge, solid shop‑math skills, and a passion for CNC work. This role is ideal for someone energetic, focused, and able to perform under deadlines in a fast‑paced environment. You must be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
What You’ll Do
  • Program mills and lathes, including zero/reference points, tool registers, offsets, compensation, and conditional switches
  • Perform calculations using basic math, geometry, and trigonometry
  • Prove part programs and verify accuracy
  • Set up mills and lathes, including three‑ and four‑jaw chucks, tools, collets, bushings, cams, gears, stops, and stock pushers
  • Indicate vises and tram heads
  • Read and interpret work orders, blueprints, engineering drawings, orthographic drawings, and GD&T
  • Plan machining processes and understand materials and specifications
  • Monitor and manage stock inventory, place orders, and verify received materials
  • Perform drilling, grooving, cutting, turning, facing, knurling, and thread chasing
  • Take precise measurements and maintain part specifications
  • Troubleshoot machining processes and adjust or reprogram controls as needed
  • Sharpen and replace worn tools
  • Follow quality assurance procedures
  • Perform preventative maintenance and follow manufacturer guidelines
  • Troubleshoot equipment and coordinate repairs when necessary
  • Handle deburring from start to finish
  • Maintain quality control of parts throughout the entire process
Equipment You Must Be Able to Use
  • Bore Gages
  • Calipers
  • Micrometers (outside, inside, depth)
  • Dial Indicators
  • Gage Blocks
  • CMMs
  • Roundness Gages
Requirements
  • Minimum of 2 years machining experience
  • Ability to understand and perform basic setups
  • Experience working in a fast‑paced machining environment
  • Must have your own tools
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Punctual, reliable, and trustworthy
  • Ability to multi‑task effectively
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Must pass a background check and drug screen

job.title: Packaing Operators
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Heavy Packaging Operator to work at a company located in the Miramar, FL area!

4- Heavy Packaging Operator
Nutraceutical Manufacturing
Location: Miramar, FL
Schedule: Monday–Friday | Schedule: 2:30   PM TO 11:00 PM
Pay Rate $16 - $17 per hour based on experience 

Benefits
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Paid time off, health insurance, and career advancement opportunities
  • Hands-on training and development in a growing industry
Position Overview
We are seeking detail-oriented and reliable GMP Packaging Operators to join our team in a fast-paced, GMP-compliant manufacturing environment. The Packaging Operator is responsible for the accurate, safe, and efficient packaging of finished products, ensuring compliance with FDA regulations, cGMP guidelines, and internal quality standards.
 
Responsibilities
  • Operate, clean, and set up packaging line equipment, including labelers, blister machines, bottle fillers, cappers, sealers, and cartoners.
  • Perform packaging of tablets, capsules, powders, or liquids in accordance with batch records and SOPs.
  • Conduct in-process quality checks (e.g., weight, torque, seal integrity).
  • Accurately complete all required documentation: packaging records, logbooks, cleaning logs.
  • Inspect finished goods for proper labeling, visible defects, and compliance with specifications.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization in packaging areas per GMP housekeeping standards.
  • Promptly report equipment malfunctions or deviations to the supervisor.
  • Support line changeovers and clearances.
  • Follow all safety procedures and participate in regular safety training.
 
Qualifications
 
  • Minimum of 1 year in a packaging role within a GMP-regulated facility (pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, or cosmetics industries preferred).
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Skills:
  • Ability to read and interpret batch records and SOPs in English.
  • Proficiency in basic math (weights, counts, measurements).
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Physically able to stand for extended periods and lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Team player with strong communication and adaptability skills.
  •  
Preferred Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of FDA, cGMP, and SOP requirements.
  • Experience with bottling, blister packaging, pouching, or other automated systems.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
  • Compensation & Benefits

Road Construction Flagger 
 
Job Location: 
Statewide Hiring Locations: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Jackson, Mount Pleasant

Hourly rate is based on the one-way distance from your home office to the assigned job site, calculated using the shortest available route in Google Maps.

Job Description:                                                          
 
What the Job Looks Like
  • Schedules are shared daily through our dispatch app (Assignar), by 7:00 PM each night.
  • Shifts typically range from 4 to 14 hours, depending on weather and project needs. (Not including travel time)
  • Work sites change daily. Statewide travel is required.
  • Overtime opportunities are available.
  • Because of the nature of roadwork, scheduled breaks aren’t always guaranteed—but we do our best to make sure you get rest when site conditions allow.
 
 
What You’ll Need
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Reliable personal vehicle (must remain on-site during your shift)
  • Proof of auto insurance (in your name/listed as an insured driver)
  • Availability for full days (sunrise to sunset), including weekends.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • No OWI/DUI within the past 5 years
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.
  • Willingness to travel up to 100+ miles one way.
 
No experience? No problem. We provide training and safety equipment.
 
As a flagger, you’re an important part of keeping both workers and drivers safe. Your responsibilities include:
  • Controlling traffic through construction zones
  • Guiding drivers safely around work areas
  • Using signs, paddles, radios, and hand signals
  • Communicating with your team to keep traffic flowing smoothly.
 
PPE Provided by JobSquad:
  • Safety vest (MDOT Class 3)

You’ll need to bring:

We’ve got you covered with a full range of benefits, including:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Plus, we offer a $100 referral bonus for every friend you bring on board—no limit.

job.title: MP Buffer
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Production to work at a company located in the Remus, MI area!

Job Title: Production   
 
Job Location: 
Remus, MI
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: 
6am to 2:30pm Monday-Friday $15.00/hr
 
 
Job Description:
 
This role involves preparing molds, mixing and pouring matrix materials, curing products, and performing final inspections. It requires strong attention to detail, adherence to safety standards, and the ability to perform hands‑on production tasks, including buffing.

Requirements
Education & Experience
  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical training or certification is a plus.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing or production environment preferred but not required.
  • REQUIRED: Previous buffing experience.
Skills & Abilities
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and standard operating procedures.
  • Proficiency with hand tools, power tools, and testing devices.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to high‑quality output.
  • Basic math and reading comprehension skills.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs.
  • Able to stand for extended periods and perform repetitive motions.
Personal Attributes
  • Strong work ethic and reliability.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to troubleshoot minor equipment issues.
  • Team‑oriented mindset with effective communication skills.
Safety & Compliance
  • Consistent adherence to all safety regulations and protocols.
  • Commitment to maintaining a clean, organized, and hazard‑free work environment.
Responsibilities
1. Clean and Prepare Molds
  • Inspect molds for residue, defects, or damage.
  • Clean thoroughly using appropriate solvents and tools.
2. Mix Matrix Materials
  • Gather all required components (resin, hardener, fillers, etc.).
  • Follow manufacturer mixing ratios and guidelines.
  • Mix thoroughly—mechanically or by hand—until fully homogeneous.
3. Pour Matrix into Molds
  • Pour from one side to reduce air bubbles and ensure even fill.
  • Tap or gently vibrate molds to release trapped air if needed.
  • Level the surface before curing begins.
4. Curing Process
  • Maintain recommended temperature and humidity conditions.
  • Allow full curing time as specified for the material.
5. Demolding & Final Inspection
  • Carefully remove cured parts by flexing molds as needed.
  • Inspect finished pieces for imperfections and perform touch‑ups if required.
